additions.label: Revert Finance deposit (empty permit data)
additions.description: Ordinary USDC lending using existing vault allowance; raw permitData must be exactly empty.
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only; no current runtime identity, balance, liquidity, funding, successful execution, complete workflow or financial-safety guarantee. Zero native value; independent grants, pauses, canonical calldata and transaction controls remain mandatory.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is immutable asset with6 decimals; rlUSDC lender shares also use6 decimals. Loan tokenId is a fixed-manager Uniswap V3 NFT and debt shares are separate loan-accounting units; neither is lender rlUSDC or raw ETH.

Plain deposit/mint and the separately scoped exact-empty permitData lending overloads pull USDC from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver. Exact-empty raw bytes skip the entire Permit2 branch; nonempty actual Permit2 execution and signature authorization entries remain excluded. No approval or signing capability is added.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Ordinary collateral deposit, borrowing, no-permit repayment, liquidity/fee withdrawal and zero-debt NFT removal are separately admitted; removal requires runtime-enforced empty callback bytes. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower lending exchange rate pro rata. Signature-bearing liquidation, transformer authority, arbitrary multicall and direct NFT callback entrypoints remain excluded.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.

Deposit floors shares; mint rounds required assets up. Interest, global/daily lending limits, token behavior and receiver validity remain onchain checks. No minimum output, maximum input or deadline is introduced.
No new overload is added to any existing multicall allowedChildren graph; existing graph identities and scope hashes are unchanged.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Deposit USDC into the lending pool and you receive rlUSDC, a vault share following the ERC-4626 standard. Your yield is the interest borrowers pay, denominated in USDC: no lockups, no reward emissions to sell.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: If most of the pool is currently borrowed, there may not be enough idle liquidity to fill your full withdrawal immediately. The protocol does not pretend otherwise, and it does not guarantee instant exit at high utilization.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: The V3Vault contract allows users to deposit a specific ERC20 token (e.g., USDC) to earn interest or borrow against their LP positions.

sourceSemantics.note: Lifecycle excerpt dates above remain retained 2026-10-23 except separately refetched lending document. No current funded execution, eligibility, balances, limits or runtime identity claim. Deposit, mint and repayment raw-bytes overloads are admitted only with exact-empty permitData, which skips the complete Permit2 branch. createWithPermit always calls the NFT manager permit and remains excluded.
